description:
Get YouTube Comments

Returns a page of top-level `comments` for a YouTube video or short identified by its 11-character `videoId` (`v`). Each comment carries its text, author (name, channel id, avatar, verified/creator flags), publish time, and raw + normalized like and reply counts. `pagination` carries the returned comment `count`, the video's total comment count (`totalCount` as shown, `extractedTotalCount` as a number), a `nextPageToken`, and a `hasdataLink` that calls this endpoint for the next page. To page through comments pass the `nextPageToken` from the response back as the `nextPageToken` parameter (the token is self-contained — `v` is not needed on continuation requests). Use to mine video comments for sentiment, feedback or moderation, or to build comment datasets.

gl.description: The two-letter country code for the country you want to limit the search to. Provide one exact documented value (245 allowed), e.g. `ac`, `af`.

hl.description: The two-letter language code for the language you want to use for the search. Provide one exact documented value (159 allowed), e.g. `af`, `ak`.

nextPageToken.description: Token to fetch the next page of comments. Pass the `nextPageToken` from a previous response; omit it for the first page.

v.description: 11-character YouTube video ID — the value of the `v=` query parameter in a watch URL (e.g. `dQw4w9WgXcQ` for `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ`). Required for the first page; omit it on continuation requests that pass `nextPageToken`.
